body: Per-district CI (0.0-1.0). Tick: passive recovery (0.001/s) + superlinear dog decay (dogs^1.5). JammerDecay (0.05/use), FlipDecay (0.08/flip). CleanAudit (+0.10), BirdCorrection (+0.15). Rogue Swarm fires at CI<=0.15 → ROGUE_SWARM event; dogs detach, FOs enter Containment. SetContainmentProgress: 3 objectives → CONTAINMENT_END + SCAR_WRITTEN (permanent scar history). Registry: GetOrCreate/Get/RogueDistricts/TickAll. 24 tests pass.
title: S119-04: server/integrity — Control Integrity + Rogue Swarm
